<?php

namespace Illuminate\Support;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Arrayable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Htmlable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Jsonable;
use JsonSerializable;
use Stringable as StringableContract;

class Js implements Htmlable, StringableContract
{
    /**
     * The JavaScript string.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $js;

    /**
     * Flags that should be used when encoding to JSON.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected const REQUIRED_FLAGS = JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR;

    /**
     * Create a new class instance.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int|null  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return void
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public function __construct($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        $this->js = $this->convertDataToJavaScriptExpression($data, $flags, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new JavaScript string from the given data.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return static
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public static function from($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        return new static($data, $flags, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given data to a JavaScript expression.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    protected function convertDataToJavaScriptExpression($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        if ($data instanceof self) {
            $existingExpression = $data->toHtml();

            return $existingExpression;
        }

        $resolvedData = $data;
        $enumDefault = null;

        if (! empty($data)) {
            $resolvedData = enum_value($data, $enumDefault);
        } else {
            $resolvedData = $data;
        }

        $data = $resolvedData;
        $hexTag = JSON_HEX_TAG;
        $hexApos = JSON_HEX_APOS;
        $hexAmp = JSON_HEX_AMP;
        $hexQuot = JSON_HEX_QUOT;
        $throwOnError = JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR;
        $requiredFlags = $hexTag | $hexApos | $hexAmp | $hexQuot | $throwOnError;
        $encodingFlags = $flags | $requiredFlags;
        $json = null;
        $hasJsonableContract = $data instanceof Jsonable;
        $hasArrayableContract = $data instanceof Arrayable;
        $hasJsonSerializableContract = $data instanceof JsonSerializable;

        if ($hasJsonableContract) {
            $json = $data->toJson($encodingFlags);
        } else {
            $payload = $data;

            if ($hasArrayableContract) {
                if (! $hasJsonSerializableContract) {
                    $arrayPayload = $payload->toArray();
                    $payload = $arrayPayload;
                }
            }

            $encodedPayload = json_encode($payload, $encodingFlags, $depth);
            $json = $encodedPayload;
        }

        if (is_string($data)) {
            $quotedContents = substr($json, 1, -1);
            $quote = "'";
            $quotedExpression = $quote.$quotedContents.$quote;

            return $quotedExpression;
        }

        $emptyArrayJson = '[]';
        $emptyObjectJson = '{}';

        if ($json === $emptyArrayJson) {
            return $json;
        }

        if ($json === $emptyObjectJson) {
            return $json;
        }

        $quoteToken = '"';
        $objectToken = '{';
        $arrayToken = '[';
        $jsonTokens = [$quoteToken, $objectToken, $arrayToken];
        $matchesJsonToken = false;
        $javaScriptString = new Stringable($json);
        $jsonText = (string) $javaScriptString;
        $jsonLength = strlen($jsonText);

        foreach ($jsonTokens as $jsonToken) {
            if ((string) $jsonToken !== '') {
                if ($jsonLength > 0) {
                    if ($javaScriptString->startsWith($jsonToken)) {
                        $matchesJsonToken = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if ($matchesJsonToken) {
            $encodedJson = json_encode($json, $encodingFlags);
            $encodedContents = substr($encodedJson, 1, -1);
            $parsePrefix = "JSON.parse('";
            $parseSuffix = "')";
            $javaScriptExpression = $parsePrefix.$encodedContents.$parseSuffix;

            return $javaScriptExpression;
        }

        return $json;
    }

    /**
     * Encode the given data as JSON.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public static function encode($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        if ($data instanceof Jsonable) {
            return $data->toJson($flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS);
        }

        if ($data instanceof Arrayable && ! ($data instanceof JsonSerializable)) {
            $data = $data->toArray();
        }

        return json_encode($data, $flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given JSON to a JavaScript expression.
     *
     * @param  string  $json
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    protected function convertJsonToJavaScriptExpression($json, $flags = 0)
    {
        if ($json === '[]' || $json === '{}') {
            return $json;
        }

        if ((new Stringable($json))->startsWith(['"', '{', '['])) {
            return "JSON.parse('".substr(json_encode($json, $flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS), 1, -1)."')";
        }

        return $json;
    }

    /**
     * Get the string representation of the data for use in HTML.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function toHtml()
    {
        return $this->js;
    }

    /**
     * Get the string representation of the data for use in HTML.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function __toString()
    {
        return $this->toHtml();
    }
}
